assumptions.comparator_supply: Protected battery rail, at least 5 V for full offset specification
assumptions.scope: DC corner analysis and conservative first-order power estimates; parasitic/transient/thermal behavior requires prototype tests.

sensor_vbat_current_limit.accuracy_condition: VS-OUT>=2.5V; current-limit accuracy is not specified in the low-dropout region.
sensor_vbat_current_limit.latch_delay_note: 33nF delay capacitor, no automatic retry. Timing-current/reference are typical values; bench-check actual delay.

buck.output_capacitors: 3 x 22 uF, 25 V X5R, Samsung CL31A226KAHNNNE; measured manufacturer typical DC-bias curve stored with sources
buck.max_duty_cycle_check: Datasheet typical off-time150ns, maximum duty98%, foldback as low as133kHz. PMOS input entry removes the previous series-diode loss. At6V battery input the conservative resistive-drop calculation gives about5.84V at the regulator. Low-input regulation still requires bench characterization.

power_budget.caveat: AO4485 max20mohm at25C,VGS=-4.5V;40mohm hot is an engineering allowance. Fuse hot resistance, buck efficiency and dropout require bench verification.

reverse_protection.limitation: Reverse battery polarity protection only; an on-state PMOS does not block reverse current from external sensor power.

battery_rail_startup.limitation: Fault timing is typical and sensor startup current can exceed steady current. Verify all connected sensors together; large capacitive loads may latch the rail off.

logic_open_drain.allowance_note: 0.60V is an engineering temperature allowance above the25C datasheet0.45V at10mA. Actual bias currents are lower; characterize over temperature.

adc.TPS1H200A_open_load_fault: FAULT can assert below10-20mA while output remains healthy. Battery fault latching uses measured output undervoltage; autonomous hardware protection remains active.
adc.diagnostic_accuracy_note: 6% is a system design allowance, not a qualified accuracy rating. Divider drift, VREFINT and ADC errors require bench verification.

unpowered_leakage.temperature_scope: BAT46W maximum at60C/50V used for positive signals up to30V; not a125C bound.
unpowered_leakage.scope: Resistive leakage-path bound only; comparator unpowered behavior, contamination and external wiring require physical power-sequencing tests.

bias_misconfiguration.all_bias_shunts_fitted: Incorrect input threshold behavior, but each source is current-limited by4.7k. No direct short through a diode.

crystal.verification: Measure startup over voltage and temperature, actual frequency, and crystal drive on first hardware.

result: All implemented DC/corner assertions passed; unmodeled limits remain pending.
